create_evaluation_run: create a new evaluation run with a unique name in the Evaluator object
delete_evaluation_run: delete an existing evaluation run by its name from the Evaluator object
get_evaluation_run: get the EvaluationObject for an existing evaluation run by its name
evaluate_predictions: evaluate predictions against labels using custom metric functions and return a DataFrame
check_valid_run_name: check if an evaluation run name is valid and exists or does not exist
